reviewer.independence: pre-GPU audit; no Modal invocation and no GPU consumption

findings.finding: The historical unconditional 1,800-A100-second reservation was not evidence-derived.
findings.resolution: The sole coordinator hash-verifies the phase budget before reservation and reserves exactly 469 wall seconds or 938 A100-seconds. No live path constant reserves 1,800 A100-seconds.

findings.finding: Modal SDK requires an integer Function timeout, while the pre-rounding budget was 468.8125 seconds.
findings.resolution: The budget records a distinct 0.1875-second SDK-granularity margin after its 25 percent safety margin. Reservation, provider timeout, call.get timeout, and outer coordinator timeout are exactly 469 seconds.

findings.finding: An abnormal launcher or settlement failure retained an active reservation indefinitely.
findings.resolution: Failure handling now clears the reservation into a distinct full-bound conservative failure charge, preserves actual GPU seconds as unavailable instead of fabricating a measurement, records cost and remaining budget, and prevents duplicate reservation or invocation identities.

findings.finding: The ledger rejected an explicitly configured larger ceiling by requiring compile-time equality with 10,800 A100-seconds.
findings.resolution: The persisted finite positive ledger ceiling is authoritative. Current v10 remains unchanged at the explicitly authorized 10,800 A100-seconds; no code silently raises it.

findings.finding: Whole-invocation settlement did not expose actual, conservative, cost, remaining-budget, and phase before/after accounting together.
findings.resolution: Settlement now records client elapsed, actual and conservative GPU-seconds/hours/cost, cumulative cost, and remaining ceiling. The fail-closed finalizer emits all 20 phase-budget rows with before/after timestamps and envelope-relative accounting; provider startup is conservative-only and explicitly not presented as a measured GPU interval.

findings.finding: The live gate evaluates current committed conservative usage plus the exact derived requirement against the unchanged configured ceiling before any Modal invocation.

Successful settlement uses max(client elapsed, remote observed allocation), validates exact two-A100 identities, clears the reservation, persists cost, and refuses any duration above the preflight bound.
